answer_1.quote: We conduct evaluations using LLaMA-3.1-8B (Team., 2024) and Mistral-7B-v0.3 , along with two benchmarks: ZsRE  and SelfCheck-GPT . ZsRE is a closed-book question answering (QA) dataset derived from zeroshot relation extraction.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to questions, such as "Who is the current president of the United States?"

answer_2.quote: We adopt three primary evaluation metrics: Reliability (Rel.), Generality (Gen.), and Locality (Loc.) . These metrics respectively assess: (1) Rel. evaluates the accuracy rate of the model editing. (2) Gen. evaluates the generalization ability of the edit to paraphrased queries, and (3) Loc. evaluates the extent to which the edit preserves the original behavior of the model on unrelated inputs.
